q: How are rebates calculated and distributed?
a: The platform charges a 0.2% trading fee on execution and allocates 20% of it as your rebate token (rates are subject to future updates).

q: Is there a limit on how many friends I can invite?
a: No limit. You can invite as many friends as you want to maximize your passive income.

q: Can I still earn rebates if my friend trades using multiple accounts?
a: Yes. Every new wallet account must bind via your link or code before its first trade to generate rebates for you.
